import hashlib, os
p = inputs["path"]
h = hashlib.sha256()
with open(p, "rb") as f:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
        h.update(chunk)
result = {"sha256": h.hexdigest(), "size": os.path.getsize(p)}
